sections.title: CNTRL/SRN PLAINS...LOWER/MID MS VALLEY
sections.text: LATEST SHORT RANGE MODEL GUIDANCE IS FAIRLY CONSISTENT REGARDING THE PROGRESSION OF UPPER TROUGH ACROSS THE SRN ROCKIES INTO THE MID/LOWER MS VALLEY REGION LATE IN THE PERIOD. BOTH THE GFS AND NAM SUGGEST A STRONG MID LEVEL SPEED MAX...90KT AT H5...WILL ROUND THE BASE OF AN INCREASINGLY NEGATIVE TILTED SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER TX BEFORE EJECTING TOWARD THE LOWER OH VALLEY. THIS EVOLUTION WILL MAINTAIN A STRONG LLJ ACROSS ERN TX INTO IL ENSURING THE GREATEST BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE RETURN WILL BE NOTED ALONG A NARROW AXIS JUST AHEAD OF THE ADVANCING FRONTAL ZONE. IT SEEMS REASONABLE THAT 60+ SFC DEW POINTS WILL OVERSPREAD MOST OF THE SLGT RISK AREA PRIOR TO CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT...ESPECIALLY AREAS SOUTH AND EAST OF KS/NERN OK. EVEN SO FORECAST SOUNDINGS DO NOT SUGGEST MUCAPE VALUES WILL EXCEED 1000 J/KG. WHILE THE SHORT RANGE MODELS APPARENTLY HAVE A GOOD HANDLE ON THE LARGE SCALE UPPER PATTERN...LARGE VARIABILITY EXISTS WITHIN THE GUIDANCE REGARDING CONVECTIVE INITIATION/MODE. 02/00Z SOUNDINGS ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR EXHIBIT A SUBSTANTIAL AMOUNT OF INHIBITION ACROSS THE CNTRL/SRN PLAINS. STRONG FORCING/MID LEVEL COOLING SHOULD ERODE THE NEGATIVE AREA ACROSS KS/OK EARLY IN THE PERIOD..

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: AN INITIAL SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED SURFACE CYCLONE WILL MOVE NEWD FROM ERN SD TO WRN ONTARIO THROUGH TONIGHT. A TRAILING COLD FRONT AND REMNANT DRYLINE WILL CONTINUE EWD ACROSS THE CENTRAL/SRN PLAINS...AS THE PRIMARY MID LEVEL TROUGH EJECTS EWD FROM ERN NM/W TX THIS MORNING TO AR BY TONIGHT.

sections.title: N TX INTO CENTRAL/NE OK THIS MORNING
sections.text: AN ONGOING BAND OF THUNDERSTORMS /ROOTED NEAR THE GROUND/ WILL LIKELY PERSIST AND MOVE EWD THROUGH THE MORNING IN THE VICINITY OF THE REMNANT DRYLINE/COLD FRONT. THIS CONVECTION HAS BEEN SUPPORTED BY A BELT OF ASCENT IN ADVANCE OF THE SRN HIGH PLAINS SHORTWAVE TROUGH...WHICH IS MOVING EWD PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY AND THE BACKING/ STRENGTHENING FLOW ALOFT NOTED IN REGIONAL PROFILER PLOTS ACROSS OK/TX. MEANWHILE...AN INFLUX OF BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS OF 60-65 F ACROSS TX/OK BENEATH THE REMNANTS OF A STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATE PLUME WILL PROVIDE SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY /MUCAPE OF 1000-1500 J PER KG/ TO MAINTAIN A RISK FOR AT LEAST ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS THROUGH THE MORNING. DEEP-LAYER AND LOW-LEVEL VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR EMBEDDED SUPERCELL AND/OR BOWING STRUCTURES...ESPECIALLY THIS MORNING WHILE THE LLJ REMAINS QUITE STRONG ACROSS N TX AND CENTRAL/ERN OK.

sections.title: E TX/ERN OK/WRN AR/MO THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: THE REMAINS OF THE MORNING CONVECTION WILL LIKELY INTENSIFY DURING THE AFTERNOON FROM E TX NWD ACROSS ERN OK/WRN AR AS LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE CONTINUES TO SPREAD NWD...AND AS THE W TX SHORTWAVE TROUGH REACHES CENTRAL TX AND DOWNSTREAM ASCENT STRENGTHENS. WARM SECTOR INSTABILITY WILL NOT BE PARTICULARLY STRONG /MLCAPE VALUES AOB 1000 J PER KG/...BUT DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR EMBEDDED BOWING/ROTATING STORMS WITH AN ATTENDANT THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS...HAIL...AND A TORNADO OR TWO. THIS CONVECTION WILL THEN SPREAD EWD ACROSS LA/AR THROUGH THE OVERNIGHT HOURS...AND NWD/NEWD ACROSS MO/IL...THOUGH THE SEVERE STORM THREAT FARTHER N AND OVERNIGHT WILL BE LIMITED BY WEAK INSTABILITY.

sections.title: LA/WRN MS OVERNIGHT
sections.text: THE STRONG SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL PIVOT EWD/ENEWD OVER NRN LA/AR OVERNIGHT AND CONTRIBUTE TO STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR. SOME CONTINUED INCREASE IN MOISTURE OVERNIGHT WILL HELP MAINTAIN INSTABILITY AND THE POTENTIAL FOR STORMS ROOTED AT OR NEAR THE GROUND. ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS...AND PERHAPS A TORNADO...WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE INTO EARLY SATURDAY AS CONVECTION REACHES THE MS RIVER IN ADVANCE OF THE COLD FRONT. ..THOMPSON/ROGERS.. 04/02/2010

sections.title: ERN PARTS OF SRN PLAINS THROUGH LOWER AND MID MS VALLEY
sections.text: A COLD FRONT EXTENDS FROM A SURFACE LOW IN NERN SD SWD THROUGH ERN NEB...ERN KS AND CNTRL OK...THEN SSWWD THROUGH CNTRL TX. THE LOW PRESSURE AREA WILL LIFT NWD INTO ERN ND/WRN MN TODAY IN ASSOCIATION WITH VORT MAX EJECTING NNEWD ALONG ERN PERIPHERY OF BROADER UPPER TROUGH. MODIFIED CP AIR HAS ADVECTED NWD THROUGH THE PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR WITH DEWPOINTS GENERALLY IN THE UPPER 50S BENEATH 7-8 C/KM MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS MULTI-LAYER CLOUDS BEGINNING TO GRADUALLY DISSIPATE AHEAD OF THE FRONT AND ONGOING CONVECTION...AND THIS WILL PERMIT DIABATIC WARMING AND DESTABILIZATION OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER TO OCCUR THIS AFTERNOON. MLCAPE WILL APPROACH 1500 J/KG OVER PARTS OF ERN TX AND THE LOWER MS VALLEY AND REMAIN BELOW 1000 J/KG FARTHER NORTH. STORMS MOVING RAPIDLY NNEWD INTO SRN IA HAVE GENERALLY BEEN IN A WEAKENING TREND...BUT MAY POSE A DAMAGING WIND THREAT THROUGH ERN IA. FARTHER SOUTH...OTHER STORMS WILL CONTINUE DEVELOPING ALONG OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES ASSOCIATED WITH ONGOING CONVECTION AND ALONG PORTIONS OF THE EWD ADVANCING COLD FRONT WITHIN ZONE OF DEEPER FORCING ATTENDING THE PROGRESSIVE UPPER TROUGH. ACTIVITY WILL LIKELY UNDERGO A GRADUAL INTENSIFICATION
